input.content: Flipping an opt-in flag to default-on (batch report: config.DETAILED_REPORT False->True) promotes latent edge-case bugs in the opt-in path onto the default path. Here stats.summarize computes sum(values)/len(values) whenever detailed is set, so report([]) went from "Items: 0" to ZeroDivisionError, violating the README contract that empty batches are valid in either mode. The test suite still passed because no test covered empty input in detailed or default mode. When reviewing default flips, exercise the newly-default path with boundary inputs (empty, zero) and require tests for default-mode edge cases, not just populated happy paths.
